worldcombat.skill.burnup.summary: Draw every flame in the body inward, then vent a cone of white fire in front: the aimed target takes full damage while other foes in the cone take the side flame. Afterwards the user is truly burned out — for a while it is no longer Fire type and cannot light another Burn Up; it can only be cast while the user is Fire type.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.description.0: The white fire deals about %1$s special damage, already including the 1.12x bonus for the user's own Fire typing; it can only be cast while the user is Fire type.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.description.1: The white fire reaches %1$s blocks and opens a %2$s degree cone, its front rushing out at %3$s blocks per tick; the aimed target takes full damage and other foes in the cone each take %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.description.2: Afterwards the user is burned out for %1$s: it no longer has the Fire type (a Fire-only user falls back to Normal), losing Fire's same-type bonus and match-up, and cannot cast Burn Up again; the typing returns when the burnout ends or is cleared.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.use.0: Scorch a cone with one blast
worldcombat.skill.burnup.use.1: Trade the Fire typing for one heavy hit
worldcombat.skill.burnup.preference.bank: On: burnout ×0.7 and 4 ticks less cooldown (regain the Fire typing sooner), but this hit is ×0.9. Off: burns longer with a longer cooldown, this hit is ×1.1.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.preference.ai.m: Beyond this distance the user closes in before kindling. Higher opens from further out.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.preference.ai.h: A target below this health ratio moves Burn Up to the front (saved for a finish). Higher spends it sooner.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.timing: Range %1$s blocks; kindle %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.growth.0: From level %1$s: Burn Up power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.growth.1: From level %1$s: Burn Up power %2$s, burst distance %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.banked.on: Banked embers: keep some fire, so the burnout lasts x0.7 and the cooldown is 4 ticks shorter (the Fire type returns sooner), at the cost of x0.9 damage on this hit.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.banked.off: All-out: burn everything for x1.1 damage on this hit, at the cost of a longer burnout and cooldown.
